events.headline: TRUMP SAYS HORMUZ STRAIT HELP ‘ON THE WAY’ AS ALLIES REJECT MILITARY ACTION
events.detail: US president refuses to identify which countries he says are responding to call for naval coalition to open trade route.

events.detail: “Si no hay respuesta o si es negativa —a la petición estadounidense—, creo que será muy malo para el futuro de la OTAN [Organización del Tratado del Atlántico Norte]”, sostuvo el presidente norteameri

events.headline: EUROPA RECHAZA LAS AMENAZAS DE TRUMP PARA FORZAR SU AYUDA EN EL ESTRECHO DE ORMU
events.detail: El presidente de EE UU insiste en la presión a sus aliados y afirma que hay países que se han comprometido a ayudarle a desatascar esa vía vital para el petróleo global, pero no especifica cuáles

events.headline: WARY ALLIES SHOW THERE'S NO QUICK FIX TO TRUMP'S IRAN CRISIS
events.detail: European leaders are hesitant to help Trump secure the Strait of Hormuz, but they know inaction on the Iran war is not really an option.

events.headline: EUROPEAN LEADERS REJECT MILITARY INVOLVEMENT IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ
events.detail: Pushback comes as US President Donald Trump says NATO allies should help secure key waterway amid soaring oil prices.

events.headline: QATAR CALLS ON IRAN TO STOP GULF ATTACKS, URGES DIPLOMATIC SOLUTION
events.detail: Qatar foreign ministry spokesman Majed al-Ansari accuses Iran of targeting civilian areas as he calls for de-escalation.
